hero.title: CSRD Compliance, Simplified.
hero.subtitle: Ecoply is your intelligent copilot for Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) compliance. We combine advanced AI with secure data integration to streamline your sustainability reporting journey.

ingestion.title: Automated Data Ingestion
ingestion.text: Connect directly to your ERP, CRM, and HR systems (Salesforce, SAP, etc.) or upload CSVs. We automatically map your raw data to ESRS data points, saving you hundreds of hours of manual entry.

generation.title: AI Draft Generation
generation.text: Our advanced LLM (Gemini Pro) analyzes your data against official ESRS standards (E1, G1, etc.) to generate compliant, audit-ready narrative drafts in seconds.

audit.title: Audit Trail & Vigilance
audit.text: Every generated sentence is linked back to its source data. Our "Auditor's Vigilance" system flags potential inconsistencies or missing data points before you publish.

step1.title: Connect Your Data
step1.text: Use our secure connectors or upload wizard to bring your operational data into the platform.

step2.title: Select a Standard
step2.text: Choose the ESRS standard (e.g., E1 Climate Change) and the specific disclosure requirement you need to report on.

step3.title: Generate & Review
step3.text: Let the AI draft your report. Review the cited sources, check the auditor's notes, and approve the final text.
